risks.title: INR/USD exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to fluctuations in the exchange rate between the U.S. dollar and the Indian rupee. Each 1% change in the exchange rate can impact operating margin by 17 basis points. The majority of headcount and delivery costs are based in India, while most revenues are in U.S. dollars.

risks.title: Increased competition in IT services
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive IT services and professional consulting sector. Competition may exert downward pressure on pricing and threaten market share.

risks.title: International regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates. Regulatory changes, including tax changes and labor law reforms in India, could impact operating costs and profitability. Changes to the India-Mauritius tax treaty could increase the effective tax rate.

risks.title: Technological disruption and AI automation
risks.score_rationale: Advancements in AI-driven technologies and automation could reduce demand for certain services currently provided to clients. The company may also face reduced ability to secure favorable pricing.

risks.title: Talent supply risks
risks.score_rationale: As a global professional services company, Cognizant relies heavily on the knowledge, experience, and skills of its employees. Availability and retention of high-quality talent is a critical factor for service delivery.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Global economic uncertainty, changes in trade policy, and tariffs may affect client demand for discretionary and transformation services. Clients may reduce spending on services during periods of uncertainty.

ai_positioning.summary: Cognizant positions AI as a core element of its client transformation strategy. The company describes itself as an AI builder providing deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, integrating GenAI into client service offerings and internal operations. It plans to make significant investments in AI capabilities to meet growing demand for transformation services toward AI-ready enterprises.
evidence: As an AI builder, we provide deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, combining our perspective with extensive knowledge of our clients' organizations to build industry-specific platforms and incorporate context into systems, AI models and custom solutions.
We increasingly use AI-based technologies, including GenAI, in our client offerings and our own internal operations.
We plan to continue to make significant investments in our AI capabilities to meet the needs of our clients and harness AI's value in a flexible, secure, scalable and responsible way.
